G3195.def: to intend, i.e. be about to be, do, or suffer something (of persons or things, especially events; in the sense of purpose, duty, necessity, probability, possibility, or hesitation)
G3195.usage: about, after that, be (almost), (that which is, things, + which was for) to come, intend, was to (be), mean, mind, be at the point, (be) ready, + return, shall (begin), (which, that) should (after, afterwards, hereafter) tarry, which was for, will, would, be yet.

G3900.def: a side-slip (lapse or deviation), i.e. (unintentional) error or (wilful) transgression

G5486.def: a (divine) gratuity, i.e. deliverance (from danger or passion); (specially), a (spiritual) endowment, i.e. (subjectively) religious qualification, or (objectively) miraculous faculty

G4052.def: to superabound (in quantity or quality), be in excess, be superfluous; also (transitively) to cause to superabound or excel
G4052.usage: (make, more) abound, (have, have more) abundance (be more) abundant, be the better, enough and to spare, exceed, excel, increase, be left, redound, remain (over and above).

G2917.def: a decision (the function or the effect, for or against ("crime"))
G2917.usage: avenge, condemned, condemnation, damnation, + go to law, judgment.

G1345.def: an equitable deed; by implication, a statute or decision

G1343.def: equity (of character or act); specially (Christian) justification

G686.def: a particle denoting an inference more or less decisive (as follows)
G686.usage: haply, (what) manner (of man), no doubt, perhaps, so be, then, therefore, truly, wherefore.

G2525.def: to place down (permanently), i.e. (figuratively) to designate, constitute, convoy
G2525.usage: appoint, be, conduct, make, ordain, set.

G5218.def: attentive hearkening, i.e. (by implication) compliance or submission

G3922.def: to come in alongside, i.e. supervene additionally or steathily

G4121.def: to do, make or be more, i.e. increase (transitively or intransitively); by extension, to superabound
G4121.usage: abound, abundant, make to increase, have over.

G166.def: perpetual (also used of past time, or past and future as well)
